title: ML models co-optimize antibody affinity and specificity in novel mutational space
summary: For emibetuzumab, CDR mutant libraries were sorted for affinity and non-specific binding and deep sequenced; ML models trained on binary labels predicted continuous metrics and generalized to novel mutations, exposing trade-offs between the two properties. Abstract-level review only; truncated reading.
ai_technology: Machine learning models on deep-mutational sort data

evidence.tested: Predictions compared with measured binding on held-out variants.
evidence.unknown: Single antibody; clinical developability not assessed; full text not read.
evidence.ai_role: Models predicted binding properties for unseen variants to select improved antibodies.
